purpose: Record curator-verified impacts identified by comparing authorized ISO 19650 source text with governed TIVERIT BIM Standards without making the external standard automatically applicable or reproducing protected source text.

rules.no_automatic_applicability: A verified relationship does not make ISO 19650 applicable to a project; applicability remains governed by the External Standards Gateway.
rules.iso_precedence_when_applicable: Where ISO 19650 is applicable and a TIVERIT rule conflicts with the applicable ISO requirement, the ISO requirement governs. TIVERIT may implement, operationalize or supplement the ISO process but shall not redefine it.
rules.no_automatic_promotion: An impact finding is curator evidence and shall not silently create or amend a normative TIVERIT requirement.
rules.no_protected_text: Store clause identity, independently authored findings and TIVERIT actions only; do not reproduce protected source text.
rules.relationship_precision: Distinguish aligned, partially aligned, gap, potential conflict and not-yet-verified findings. Terminology similarity alone is insufficient.

findings.assessment: TIVERIT S2 governs PIR/AIR/EIR interfaces and delivery planning, but its own parent object records OIR as source-data-required and EIR as distributed implementation rather than a standalone governed S2 object.
findings.curator_action: Create a governed decision for completing the OIR/PIR/AIR/EIR demand chain without importing protected external text.

findings.assessment: ISO 19650-2 defines task-team TIDPs that identify information containers and a Master Information Delivery Plan established by the lead appointed party through aggregation of the TIDPs. TIVERIT's source-era expansion 'Model Information Delivery Plan' was a terminology conflict, not a container-planning concept failure.
findings.curator_action: Audit remaining TIDP ownership and field semantics during the S2 information-requirements pass; do not revert MIDP to Model Information Delivery Plan in ISO-aligned use.

findings.assessment: Round 001 reconciles the pre-appointment tender-response sequence to ISO 19650-2:2018 5.3.2-5.3.7. The pre-appointment BEP is treated as one tender-response component; each task team retains separate capability/capacity evidence; the prospective lead appointed party aggregates those assessments, establishes the proposed mobilization plan and information-delivery risk assessment, and compiles the available tender-response components. TIVERIT supplementary interview topics do not substitute for ISO content groups, ISO functions are not inferred from TIVERIT job titles, and missing project evidence remains unresolved rather than invented.
findings.curator_action: No further 5.3.2-5.3.7 architecture correction required in Round 001. Project implementations must supply project-specific evidence and mappings; future audits may refine implementation fields without redefining the ISO sequence.

findings.assessment: TIVERIT explicitly represents WIP, Shared, Published and Archived states. A second-pass audit is required for container identifiers, codification, status/revision/classification metadata, transition audit evidence and controlled access rather than assuming state-name alignment proves complete conformance.
findings.curator_action: Audit S3 metadata, transition-history and access-control requirements against existing registries and production standards.

findings.assessment: Architecture, CDE/ACC implementation, role-resolution doctrine and conformance coverage are reconciled to the applicable ISO 19650 backbone. ISO functions have no default TIVERIT job-title mapping; project evidence is required.
findings.curator_action: No further architecture correction required in Round 001.

findings.assessment: TIVERIT contains coordination, delivery, information-structure and conformance mechanisms, but no single governed exchange gate currently expresses the verified review dimensions as an executable exchange decision system.
findings.curator_action: Design a TIVERIT-native Information Exchange Gate and map its checks to existing S3/S5/S7/S8 authorities.

findings.assessment: The existing TIVERIT security gate preserves unresolved applicability and routes applicable requirements, but it remains an applicability/routing gate rather than a complete sensitivity-assessment system.
findings.curator_action: Retain the gate boundary and design downstream security-assessment/responsibility objects only where chosen or required.

findings.assessment: TIVERIT correctly distinguishes delivery-to-operation interfaces from operational governance but does not yet implement a complete standalone operational information-management lifecycle.
findings.curator_action: Treat expansion into AIM/OIR operational governance as an explicit scope decision.

provenance.curation_note: Round 001 applies ISO-first precedence when ISO 19650 is applicable. ISO-IMP-003 and ISO-IMP-005 are reconciled for Round 001; ISO-IMP-002 records the accepted MIDP terminology correction. The register does not assert automatic project applicability or blanket ISO conformance.
